definitions.explanation: eating small amounts of food; having a modest appetite

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少食|しょうしょく}です。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少食|しょうしょく}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: She's a light eater, so she always leaves food on her plate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{少食|しょうしょく}で、⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重視|じゅうし}する→重視する：26832_juushisuru⟧。
examples.english: I've been a light eater since childhood, so I value quality over quantity.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{少|しょう} (small, few) + {食|しょく} (eating, food)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {少食|しょうしょく} (light eater) ↔ ⟦{大食|おおぐ}い→大食い：08341_oogui⟧ (big eater)
- {少食|しょうしょく} (light eater) ↔ {健啖家|けんたんか} (hearty eater)

USAGE:
- Used as a noun or na-adjective
- Can describe a person or their eating habits

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{小食|しょうしょく}→小食：16900_shoushoku⟧ - variant kanji with same meaning
- ⟦{腹八分目|はらはちぶんめ}→腹八分目：08318_harahachibunme⟧ - eating in moderation
- ⟦{食|た}べ{過|す}ぎ→食べ過ぎ：28819_tabesugi⟧ - overeating
